title: Bountys+
description: A very feature rich premium bounty plugin
body:
Bounty+
Advanced Bounty Hunting System for Paper 1.21.11
Bounty+ is a powerful and immersive bounty hunting plugin designed for SMP servers. It expands the traditional bounty system with tracking mechanics, interactive GUIs, real-time target updates, and competitive leaderboards.
Players can place bounties on enemies, while hunters track them down using periodic coordinate updates. This creates exciting PvP gameplay where players must either hunt or survive.
Developed by Unknown Studios, Bounty+ is optimized for Paper servers and built to provide smooth performance and engaging gameplay.
Core Features
⚔ Advanced Bounty System
Players can place bounties on other players with a reward amount. When the target is eliminated by a hunter, the hunter receives the bounty reward.
Bounties include:
Reward amount
Expiry timer
Active hunters tracking the target
🧭 Player Tracking System
Hunters can track bounty targets using the hunt system.
After starting a hunt:
Every 30 minutes, hunters receive the target’s coordinates and world.
Only players actively hunting the target receive updates.
Updates are sent directly in chat.
This creates a cat-and-mouse gameplay experience where targets must stay alert while hunters close in.
🖥 Interactive Bounty GUI
Use the command /bounty see to open the Bounty GUI.
The GUI displays:
Player head
Target name
Bounty reward amount
Time remaining before expiry
Current dimension/world
Last known coordinates
Hunters can simply click the player head to start hunting the target.
📢 Global Bounty Announcements
Whenever a new bounty is placed:
A global chat message announces the bounty.
A title message appears on all players' screens.
This ensures everyone on the server knows that a new target has been marked.
🏆 Bounty Hunter Leaderboard
Bounty+ includes a competitive leaderboard showing the top bounty hunters on the server.
Commands:
/bounty leaderboard
/bounty lb
The leaderboard GUI displays:
Player heads
Player names
Total bounties hunted
Players compete to become the server’s best bounty hunter.
Commands
/hunt <player>
Start hunting a bounty target.
/bounty see
Open the bounty list GUI.
/bounty leaderboard
Open the bounty hunter leaderboard.
/bounty lb
Shortcut for leaderboard.
Perfect For
SMP servers
PvP focused gameplay
Competitive communities
Custom survival experiences
Server Compatibility
Minecraft Version: 1.21.11
Server Software: Paper
Developer: Unknown Studios
